protocol.purpose: Optimization conditioning sensitivity control; exploratory, not a replacement primary analysis.
protocol.selection: original-training inner-validation cross-entropy; test rows untouched
protocol.extra_control: Unregularized whitened fit to separate preconditioning from changes in the L2 prior; reuse the CV fit if its selected lambda is zero.

healthy.selection_criterion: lowest inner-validation cross-entropy; exact ties use smaller regularization
healthy.regularization_definition: mean CE + 0.5 * lambda * squared Frobenius norm of transformed-coordinate readout

feature_transform.definition: P = V diag(sqrt(n_train) / max(singular_value, floor)) V.T; H_transformed = H @ P
feature_transform.regularization_prior: L2 on transformed coefficients equals ||P^-1 W_original||_F^2; with no flooring this is covariance-weighted L2 in original coordinates.

optimization.message: CONVERGENCE: NORM OF PROJECTED GRADIENT <= PGTOL
